1.1.0.0.added: Debugger will display the name given to the behaviour.

1.1.1.0.added:
- Fix bug thatcan make "On death" trigger twice for a single lethal hit
- Create Guide

1.2.0.0.added:
- Add Temporary Health Pools support.
- Set custom Absorption rates for Health & Temporary Health.
- Temporary Health (Absorption Rate / Decay Rate)

1.2.0.2.added: - Damage priority for Temporary Health : A number assigned to each pool. Pools are consumed in ascending order (lowest number first). Default is `0`. Equal-priority pools are consumed in creation order.

1.2.1.0.added:
- Add Revive Action
- On Health Changed Condition
- Trigger condition for Health pool Added.

1.3.0.0.added:
- Status Effects: named statuses in seconds or turns, with stacks, reapply modes and damage/heal over time.
- Advance status turns action for turn-based games.
- On status / On any status triggers (event dropdown), status conditions and expressions.
- Pool absorption multiplier, global or per status (Set status modifier); PoolCount / PoolByIndex.
- Debug Mode (logs events and ignored actions), Enabled and Clear Statuses on Death properties; Set enabled / Is enabled.
- Example project; Guide covers statuses, scripting and upgrading.
1.3.0.0.changed:
- "Temporary Health" is now "Health Pools" (display names only, existing projects unaffected).
- Event sheet text now shows the object and behavior name.
- Temp... expressions deprecated; use the new Pool... expressions.
- Deprecated ACEs are now hidden from pickers, incl. Set health pool decay/absorption rate (use Set health pool rates). Existing events keep working.
- Debugger: Statuses section; pools shown as pool[name].

1.3.0.1.changed: - update the addon description to include things related to the new featureset.
